basics.name: Adhithyan Sakthivelu
basics.summary: PhD Student at The University of Texas at Austin in the Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering. Research interests in Optimization and Control of Water-Energy Systems.

work.summary: Analyzed and processed raw customer data, transformed them to Salesforce compatible schema, and built automated algorithm for data housekeeping. Customized and configured Salesforce Lightning Platform and Apttus CPQ managed package for Lead-to-Cash lifecycle.
highlights: Data analysis and transformation for Salesforce compatibility

education.institution: The University of Texas at Austin
education.area: PhD in Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering
Master of Science in Civil and Environmental Engineering - Atmosphere & Energy
Bachelor of Technology in Instrumentation and Control Engineering

publications.name: Auction Theory and Device Bidding Functions for Transactive Energy Systems: A Review
publications.summary: Comprehensive review of auction theory and device bidding functions for transactive energy systems. Equal contribution with A. Sreekumar.
publications.authors: A. Sreekumar*, A. Sakthivelu*, and L. Kiesling

publications.name: A Real-Time Limit Order Book as a Market Mechanism for Transactive Energy Systems
publications.publisher: IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
publications.summary: Published a novel LOB market mechanism for price discovery and order-matching for real-time retail electricity markets. Selected as one of the best conference papers.
publications.authors: A. Sreekumar, A. Sakthivelu, R. Baltaduonis, L. Kiesling, S. Hoedl, and D. P. Chassin

presentations.name: Risk-aware bidding strategy for industrial participation in DR markets
presentations.description: Developed risk-aware optimal bidding strategies using Monte Carlo methods, model predictive control, and grid-search; implemented in case study wastewater treatment facilities. Designed a parametric modular DR event simulator for stochastic analysis.

presentations.name: Heuristic bidding strategies for DERs in TESS Markets
presentations.description: Formulated heuristic bidding strategies for HVAC, batteries, and EVs (DERs) based on customer preferences and market data for maximizing utility. Validated the strategies with physical devices using EcoPort, Emporia and Tesla fleet API communication protocols.

presentations.name: A real-time limit orderbook framework for TESS
presentations.description: Published a novel LOB market mechanism for price discovery and order-matching for real-time retail electricity markets; selected as one of the best conference papers.

teaching.description: Mentored two undergraduate researchers through the SURGE fellowship on creating a machine-readable database for incentive-based DR programs, comprising of 140 programs across utilities in the US.
Conducted indoor rock-climbing classes based on experiential learning, with focus on rope safety, injury prevention and physical efficiency skills.
Organized yoga sessions for community building, with focus on creative expression of movement and breathwork. Completed Diploma in Yoga Education and Therapy from Sri Paranjothi Yoga College, India.

portfolio.name: Online US Wind Energy Atlas for potential windfarm development
portfolio.description: Built a website tool for energy developers and policy makers to disseminate feasible areas of windfarm development in the United States using ArcGIS online platform; got presented at Glasgow COP26.

portfolio.name: Optimized Operation of HVAC system with TOU electricity pricing and weather prediction data
portfolio.description: Created a physics-based (ETP) MPC model for electric heat pumps that minimizes the total cost while maintaining comfort for the customers given the electricity retail price and weather prediction.

portfolio.name: An Energy-Efficient Ride-Sharing Algorithm Using Distributed Convex Optimization
portfolio.description: Developed a ride-sharing optimization with focus on energy-efficiency and decentralized decision-making (ADMM) agents for rider pickup and drop-off, as part of localized clusters of connected cars.

research.institution: Water & Energy Efficiency for the Environment (WE3) Lab, Stanford University
research.description: Developing energy optimization algorithms and bidding strategies for water and industrial systems in demand response and energy markets.

research.institution: SLAC National Accelerator Lab & Post Road Foundation
research.description: Developing distributed energy resource (DER) bidding strategies and designing markets for transactive (peer-to-peer) energy system services (TESS).

leadership.description: Led four-day breakout room discussions with faculties from Stanford and IIT Bombay on collaborative research opportunities between the two institutions, resulting in a white paper.

leadership.organization: Nakshatra, The Astronomy Club of NIT Trichy
leadership.description: Managed the administrative activities of the club, and organized "Stardust," a two-day inter-mural astronomy fest with expert lectures, workshops, and stargazing sessions.
